# BongoCat model assets

- Upstream: https://github.com/vladelaina/BongoCat
- Pinned commit: `5b979d85fe2cbddb064ac40cfd3e32de437891e2`
- Synced on: 2026-09-08
- Upstream paths: `resources/assets/models/standard`, `keyboard`, and `gamepad`
- Local paths: `bongo-standard`, `bongo-keyboard`, and `bongo-gamepad`

The three bundled model directories, including their Live2D model files,
textures, motions, expressions, audio, covers, backgrounds, and input artwork,
are distributed by the upstream project under the MIT license in
`LICENSE-MIT`.

Only the model assets were synchronized. BongoCat's C/C++ native runtime is
AGPL-3.0-only and is not copied into this application. The 514cc pet runtime is
an independent Web/Tauri implementation.
